booking.title: Book a new work order
booking.desc: Order service or maintenance for your company.
booking.descriptionPlaceholder: What do you need help with?
booking.slotHint: Pick an available day in the overview below, or enter a date and time window yourself.
booking.dateHint: You can also pick an available day in the overview at the bottom of the page.
booking.successDuplicateTitle: Your request has already been received
booking.nextStep1: The office reviews the request and checks that the equipment and time fit.
booking.nextStep2: You receive a confirmation with the final time. If you picked an available day, we will try to keep it.
booking.nextStep3: If you need to change or cancel, you can do so under “Your requests” until the deadline.

errors.invalid: Check the date, time window and contact information.
errors.rateLimited: You have sent many requests in a short time. Try again later.

errors.deadlinePassed: The deadline for changing this request has passed. Contact the office directly.
errors.generic: The request could not be sent right now. Please try again shortly.
